## What's new in v1.1.0

### Finds your Stremio server for you — no more typing addresses

Previously you had to type your streaming server's address into
Settings → Server with the TV remote, where one wrong character (`/` instead of
`:`) silently broke it.

Now the app does it:

- **On launch**, if your server isn't answering, the app searches your network
  and asks *"Stremio server found — use it?"*, showing which device it is
  (e.g. *LG TV (webOS) · v4.20.11*). Press **OK**.
- **Press YELLOW** at any time to search and pick a server yourself.
- **If your router gives the server a new address**, the next launch notices
  and offers the new one — this is the most common reason torrents suddenly
  stop working.
- Choose **Not now** and that server won't be offered automatically again.

**Upgrading from v1.0.0:** just install over it — you stay signed in. If you
had typed a server address that has since changed, you'll be offered the new
one on first launch.
